newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil still seen competing for mining investments.
newsitem.headline: Brazil still seen competing for mining investments.

text.p: Brazil has come a long way in removing barriers to foreign investment in its mining sector but must still compete fiercely against numerous other countries, said the designated chief economist for the RTZ-CRA concern.

David Humphreys, in Brasilia for a minerals and oil sector seminar, told Reuters a "certain capital rationing" was taking place among the major international players and that this could dent Brazil's hopes of a flood of investment.
